completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "In the excerpts, carburetor icing accidents typically involve atmospheric conditions conducive to icing, often serious icing at glide/descent power, as shown by icing probability charts [20190211X72201:factual][20180903X05707:factual][20190907X64846:factual][20210830103775:factual].
